decisionRules: Do not convert family-level data into exact SKU truth.
Do not treat a published beam angle as measured photometry.
Do not mix CCT, wattage, optic or driver photometry across configurations.
Do not mark photometry received until the raw supplier or laboratory file is stored and hashed.
A compact physical head does not outrank a larger head if exact controlled photometry cannot be obtained.
Final selection may remain open between the two finalists until supplier returns are complete.
nextControlledStep: Obtain supplier responses and exact raw photometry, then run the existing candidate evaluator and LM-63 ingestion pipeline before any final selection.
